bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
old="sha256:0b63fb73669dc7d7ccf1cf9b3012f596710e9faa8eedc5e354151ec3dfb0025d"
expected="3f04f559106adee57a27349004fdca5e1d03a4ae62155e767a5b766f36cdb57b"
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
clean="$root/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old" || exit 70
test "$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)" = "$old" || exit 71
test -f "$clean"
test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt"
test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt"
test -r "$HOME/.config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download 43560438447 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp" >/dev/null
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected" || exit 72
printf 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local\nCOPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' > "$tmp/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false --tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-button-53451aa --file "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-button-53451aa --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
candidate="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-button-53451aa)"
override="$tmp/override.yaml"
printf 'secrets:\n  db_password:\n    file: %s\n  bot_token:\n    file: %s\n' "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" > "$override"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$clean" -f "$override" config -q >/dev/null
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-button-rollback-53451aa
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-button-53451aa gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
rollback() {
 docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:profile-button-rollback-53451aa gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p deploy -f "$clean" -f "$override" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$clean" -f "$override" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null; then rollback; exit 82; fi
sleep 5
actual="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || true)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || true)"
if test "$actual" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != true; then rollback; exit 83; fi
printf 'PROFILE_BUTTON_FIX_PRODUCTION=PASS\nSOURCE_HEAD=53451aa78635ba7e94b7db63544e0e7c020d54d7\nCANDIDATE_IMAGE=%s\nRUNNING=true\nOLD_IMAGE_RETAINED=YES\n' "$candidate" | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
